reviews.title: Great RAM
reviews.comment:
Corsair Vengeance and Vengeance Pro RAM has always been pretty solid stuff for when you need reliability. However this kit uses SK Hynix chips and big 32GB modules so isn't the most compatible to begin with. It simply won't boot with XMP in my AM5 motherboard after the SoC voltage patch. It worked just fine before that. That voltage adjustment combined with my sensitive X3D processor seems to make this kit out of reach.
I can however run the XMP rated timings if I input them manually and lower the kit's speed. I'm currently sitting at 5200MHz and getting great performance with a 7900X3D. Even at that lowered speed the kit's XMP timings are actually quite comparable to or better than many others. DDR5 isn't exactly in its infancy anymore but AM5 certainly is. I will continue to tweak this kit and am currently very happy with its performance. However this kit has very aggressive timings for 6000MHz, and might be better suited to an Intel build. Stick to EXPO rated kits for AM5. I am sure if I am willing to play with some timings, I might still get 6000MHz out of them. It's not the fault of the RAM but the platform itself.
EDIT: The situation has changed. This RAM now runs full XMP speeds 6000MHz CL30 with zero problems with my 7900X3D. Considering some chips have actually had this issue I assumed mine was to blame as well. Nope. It was my motherboard being funny. After some BIOS updates stability is fixed entirely and everything works much better. AM5 is a newer platform after all. The performance boost is lovely.
reviews.author: Jeffery Jelinski

reviews.title: Works as expected
reviews.comment: Bought the 96 (2x48GB) version. Worked exactly as expected. Before, I was getting slight RAM throttle from current games (from the *used* VRAM, not just *allocated*), plus with doing some casual AI hobby work on the side, 96GB is a great capacity. Speeds as expected. I even had an AMD CPU, and despite this listing being Intel XMP, speeds are exactly what you'd expect enabling EXPO. Don't really care about the RGB but it's solid.  As with every RAM module, trivial to install and stable.
reviews.author: Kevin

reviews.title: Blazing Fast RAM – Perfect for Gaming, Editing & Streaming!
reviews.comment: The CORSAIR VENGEANCE RGB DDR5 6400 is an absolute beast! I installed it in my gaming PC build, and the performance boost is incredible. Games run buttery smooth, and video editing is noticeably faster with no lag. The RGB lighting looks amazing and syncs perfectly with my setup. I’m so impressed that I’m planning to buy another 64GB to handle even more intensive editing and live streaming. If you want top-tier speed and performance, this RAM is a must-have! Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Perfect Cents
